parameters.help_en: Task ID. Only a single ID can be passed. It is consistent with the input parameter TaskId in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID，和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html中入参TaskId一致
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Video cropping mode. Values:


1: crop while maintaining ratio.

2 (default): keep margins while maintaining ratio
parameters.help_zh:
视频的裁剪模式。取值：


1：保持比例裁剪。

2（默认值）：保持比例留边
parameters.name: crop_mode

parameters.help_en: Encoding option. See the MediaEncode enumeration values below
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项，请参见下文中的MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

parameters.help_en:
Stream mixing mode. Values:

0: single-stream relay. No stream mixing or transcoding. Only the original single stream is relayed. No need to configure stream mixing and transcoding parameters.
1: stream mixing and transcoding (default). Supports stream mixing and transcoding output.

Valid parameters in single-stream relay mode: StreamType, SourceType.
Valid parameters in stream mixing and transcoding mode: MediaEncode, LayoutIds, BackgroundColor, SubSpecUsers, CropMode, UserPanes, Backgrounds, Watermarks
parameters.help_zh:
混流模式。取值：

0：单路转推，不混流转码，仅转推原始单路流，无需配置混流转码参数。
1：混流转码（默认值），支持混流转码输出。

单路转推模式下有效参数：StreamType、SourceType。
混流转码模式下有效参数：MediaEncode、LayoutIds、BackgroundColor、SubSpecUsers、CropMode、UserPanes、Backgrounds、Watermarks
parameters.name: mix_mode

parameters.help_en:
User video input stream in single-stream relay mode. Values:

camera: camera.
shareScreen: screen sharing
parameters.help_zh:
单路转推模式下用户视频输入流。取值：

camera：摄像头。
shareScreen：屏幕共享
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
Audio stream relayed in single-stream relay mode. Values:

0 (default): relay the original stream.
1: relay only the audio stream.
2: relay only the video stream
parameters.help_zh:
单路转推模式下转推音频流。取值：

0（默认值）：转推原始流。
1：仅转推音频流。
2：仅转推视频流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Background color RGB. The default is 0 (black).

The calculation formula is `R + G × 256 + B × 65536`. Values of R (red), G (green), and B (blue): 0 to 255
parameters.help_zh:
背景色RGB，默认是0（黑色）。

计算公式为`R + G × 256 + B × 65536`，R（红）、G（绿）、B（蓝）的取值：0~255
parameters.name: background_color
